title: 本地看板读取 API 与进程边界
status_note: Implementation and module tests are complete. Batch reconnection, the 6.1 facade wiring and the fix/acceptance phase are not part of this record; status becomes accepted only in that later phase.
record_commit: the commit containing this record file
worktree_note: Recorded with ~ for the user home because the frozen contract privacy validator rejects absolute home-directory paths inside plans/; the absolute path stays in the execution session.
batch_state: batch 6 is open; this module creates no PR, merges no branch and publishes no release
evidence_tree: clean checkout of 396d3dc after `python scripts/dev.py setup-node` (or an equivalent src/thu_assistant/node_modules link); dev.py test needs the tough-cookie runtime dependency
outputs: exactly the seven frozen routes plus an optional static shell: /api/v1/health, /services, /services/{service_id}, /query/{service_id}/{operation}, /todos, /calendar, /resources; no prepare, execute, payment, upload, model, key or config route exists
GET and HEAD only; every other method returns 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD before the facade is reached
loopback binding only: 0.0.0.0, ::, localhost and any external address are refused before a socket opens; port 0 gives an ephemeral port and an explicit port is honoured
Host header exact allowlist (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1]) with the bound port, blocking DNS rebinding
Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site checks reject cross-site browser requests; no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header is ever emitted

process-bound sessions: a 0600 bootstrap file plus X-Openthu-Bootstrap for automated clients, and a trusted loopback navigation for the browser shell; the token never enters a URL, a log line or the shared configuration
session cookie is HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, without Domain and with a bounded Max-Age; Secure is deliberately not set because some browsers drop it on loopback HTTP
session ids are stored only as SHA-256 digests; idle and absolute expiry are distinguished from an unknown cookie, and a restart invalidates every old cookie
per-session sliding-window rate limit (120 requests / 10 s) and a 10 s minimum interval for an identical expensive read; an opaque cursor resume is not treated as a refresh
request bounds: 64 KiB body ceiling, no GET/HEAD body, 2048-character path, 8192-character query, 4096-character parameters object, page_size 1..200 with default 50
parameters accept only a bounded JSON object with safe keys; url/uri/href/method/headers/host/token/authorization/proxy/file and similar keys are rejected so the API cannot become a generic forwarder
path traversal, encoded dot segments, backslashes, NULs and double slashes are rejected before routing; static assets resolve under the configured directory and a symlink escape is not served

local paging safety net slices a facade page larger than page_size, mints an opaque lac1 cursor bound to session, route, parameters and page size, expires it after 600 s and carries a trailing facade cursor forward on the last slice

per-request deadline (default 30 s) with cooperative cancellation; a timed-out source returns 504/TIMEOUT while other cards keep serving, and stop() cancels this instance's tokens and closes its socket in bounded time

display projection drops exact-match credential, member, private-path and internal-exception keys, redacts home/Windows/temp paths and token shapes, caps text and depth, and replaces non-finite numbers instead of emitting invalid JSON
links survive only when they are https on tsinghua.edu.cn and are not a CAS/SSO/login/auth redirect; arbitrary and auth-flow links become null with LOCAL_API_LINK_WITHHELD

every response is a result-envelope-v1 object carrying request_id, display.state, display.message, display.next_step, display.completeness, display.provenance and display.paging; failures keep an error object and an explicit display state
AUTH_REQUIRED from a campus source stays HTTP 200 with display.state LOGIN_REQUIRED and a next step pointing to the existing controlled entry; the local API never retries a campus login

static shell is optional and served only from the configured directory with an allowlisted content type, no-store, CSP and X-Frame-Options; without it the API still runs and / returns LOCAL_API_UI_NOT_INSTALLED
no subprocess, signal, os.kill or outbound HTTP import exists in the module; one instance owns one socket, one executor and one bootstrap file
28 LOCAL_API_* error codes were added to error-classification-v1 and mirrored in source_state; no existing code or category changed

verified_cases: the implemented GET route set equals the frozen local-read-api-v1 endpoint list, and the method set is exactly GET plus HEAD
a scan of the route inventory finds no execute, prepare, action, payment, submit, upload, cancel, renew, book, model, generate, key, credential, config, proxy or download path
Host: evil.example and Host with the wrong port return 403 before any facade call; the localhost alias with the bound port is accepted
cross-site Origin values (https, null, wrong port) and Sec-Fetch-Site cross-site/same-site return 403 before any facade call; the exact origin returns 200
POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/OPTIONS/TRACE return 405 with Allow: GET, HEAD and never reach the facade, including POST / on the static shell
a GET body returns 400 LOCAL_API_REQUEST_BODY_NOT_ALLOWED and a body above 65536 bytes returns 413 LOCAL_API_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE
unknown routes, an execute route, encoded traversal and backslash paths return 400/404 without routing, file access or a facade call
a bootstrap token from the 0600 file establishes an HttpOnly/SameSite=Strict cookie; the token is absent from the response body, headers and access logs
an invalid bootstrap token and an expired bootstrap token are distinguished; an old cookie from a stopped instance is rejected by a new instance
an expired session and an unknown cookie are distinct; a CSRF token is produced and verified but is only a helper because no non-read route exists
page_size 0/201 returns INVALID_ARGUMENT_RANGE and a non-numeric page_size returns INVALID_ARGUMENT_TYPE without a facade call
unknown or duplicate query parameters, forbidden parameter keys (url/method/token), malformed JSON and an oversized parameters object are rejected before the facade

a five-item facade page is sliced into 2/2/1 with opaque cursors, no duplicate ids and a single facade call; a cursor reused with another page size or session returns CURSOR_QUERY_MISMATCH; a cursor expires after 600 s
a facade page carrying its own next_cursor still ends with that cursor after the local slices, and complete stays false
a 1 s slow source returns 504 TIMEOUT while /health returns 200 in the same instance; stop() cancels the in-flight token and returns within 2 s
two instances keep independent sockets, sessions and bootstrap files; stopping one leaves the other serving
a business AUTH_REQUIRED result is HTTP 200, display LOGIN_REQUIRED, has a controlled-entry next step and is not retried
a PARTIAL result and an incomplete OK result are both displayed as PARTIAL, never as READY
injected cookie/token/member/path/session/jwt fields are dropped, home and Windows paths are redacted, and Bearer/JWT values are replaced before the browser sees them
only an https tsinghua.edu.cn link without a CAS/SSO/login/ticket marker survives; an evil host and an auth redirect become null with LOCAL_API_LINK_WITHHELD
every exercised route and every error body validates against result-envelope-v1 and carries request_id, Cache-Control: no-store, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff and no CORS wildcard
a server constructed without a facade starts, serves the shell-less API and reports UNKNOWN plus ADAPTER_REQUIRED/BLOCKED instead of an empty success
the static shell refuses traversal and a symlink escape, sets a same-origin CSP and does not create a session for a cross-site navigation
the local_api sources contain no subprocess, signal, os.kill or outbound HTTP client, so the module cannot end another browser or assistant process
limits: The real 6.1 business facade does not exist yet. The production stub UnavailableFacade starts without a campus account and reports ADAPTER_REQUIRED/BLOCKED; batch integration must construct LocalApiServer with 6.1's adapter for the protocol in src/thu_assistant/local_api/facade.py. Until then the dashboard shows a capability gap, not data.

local-read-api-v1 declares next_cursor on /todos, /calendar and /resources but omits the request field. The server accepts an opaque cursor on those routes as a documented extension; 1.1/8.1 must revise the frozen contract or drop paging there. Every other parameter is exactly the frozen list.

The static shell is only a seam: 6.2 serves an optional static_dir and owns no HTML. 7.1 owns src/thu_assistant/web_assets and must pass it; without it / returns LOCAL_API_UI_NOT_INSTALLED while the JSON API keeps working.

The browser session bootstrap trusts a loopback navigation with Sec-Fetch-Site none/same-origin; the automated client uses the 0600 bootstrap file and header. Another process of the same OS account is treated as trusted because it can already read the profile, while remote pages are blocked by Host, Origin and fetch metadata.
Secure is not set on the session cookie because some browsers refuse it over http://127.0.0.1. Protection is the loopback-only bind plus Host/Origin checks; a future TLS front end must add Secure.
No non-read route exists, so the CSRF helper is tested but unused. Any future refresh or write route must require both an allowed origin and the CSRF token before doing work.
Rate limits are engineering bounds, not school rules: 120 requests / 10 s per session and a 10 s interval for an identical expensive read. A different query or a cursor resume is not blocked.
Bootstrap file ownership and mode checks are POSIX-only; on Windows the file stays under the per-user state directory and the session remains process-local, but the 0600 assertion is skipped.

Display projection drops exact-match sensitive keys and redacts known token/path shapes. It is not a general data-loss-prevention system: adapters must still keep raw credentials, member values and private paths out of envelopes.

The local paging safety net refuses a facade page above 5000 items or 16 MiB with 502 LOCAL_API_RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE instead of silently truncating a success. A correct facade should page at the source.

One full-suite attempt hit tests/test_action_framework.py::test_concurrent_execute_dispatches_once with STATE_READ_FAILED. It is a 4.4-owned concurrency race, touches no 6.2 code and passed on the immediate full rerun (1390 passed); the module record keeps it visible for 4.4/8.1 rather than hiding it.
This module was verified with synthetic facades and loopback HTTP only. No real campus account, source, model or browser was used, and no booking, submission or payment exists in the route table.
rollback: Delete src/thu_assistant/local_api/ and tests/test_local_api.py and revert the additive LOCAL_API_* registrations in contracts/v0.2/error-classification.json and src/thu_assistant/source_state.py. There is no store or schema migration. Remove leftover <state>/local-api/bootstrap-*.json files from a crashed instance; sessions are memory-only and expire with the process. MCP, CLI, campus adapters and the dashboard assets are untouched.
